opening: The insides of both my cheeks have turned blackish.
Several of my fingernails have brownish-black discoloration.
My toenails have dark streaks running along them too.
I have bullous pemphigoid; it's in remission, and I'm here for my routine follow-up.

opening.text: I'm here for my routine follow-up for bullous pemphigoid, which is currently in remission. I've noticed that the insides of both my cheeks have turned blackish, and it has been gradually increasing. I also have brownish-black discoloration on several of my fingernails, and dark streaks running along my toenails. I'm White (Caucasian).
